The Cagayan de Oro Port Zone, as expanded, is hereby
placed under the administrative jurisdiction of the Philippine Ports Authority,
which shall, consistent with the regional industrial plans of the Government,
implement a program for the proper zoning, planning, development and
utilization of the port.

All other orders, proclamations and issuances or portions
thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this lot
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
day of November, in the year of
